en.name: Photriya
en.subtitle: Capture & imagine colours
en.short_description: Capture, analyze & imagine colors with AI-powered creativity.
en.description:
Photriya — the most beautiful color capture and AI imagination app.

CAPTURE & ANALYZE
Point your camera at anything and instantly identify every color in the scene. Get precise HEX, RGB, HSL, and CMYK values, color temperature, luminance, and AI-powered color names. Discover complementary, analogous, triadic, and tetradic color harmonies in real time.

PLAYGROUND — AI IMAGINATION
Transform any photo into stunning artwork with our AI-powered Playground. Choose from 10 artistic styles (Watercolor, Oil Painting, Anime, Cinematic, Neon Noir, and more) and 8 moods (Serene, Dramatic, Ethereal, Romantic, and more). Describe your vision and watch Photriya bring it to life.

LIBRARY & HISTORY
Save, organize, and search your color captures and imaginations. Build custom palettes, tag your favorites, and export in any format. Share your palettes with a public link.

WORLD-CLASS DESIGN
Photriya features a stunning dark glassmorphism UI with fluid animations, haptic feedback, and a design system inspired by the world's best creative apps.

FEATURES
• Real-time camera color detection
• AI photo analysis with scene, mood, and lighting detection
• 10 AI art styles × 8 moods for imagination generation
• HEX, RGB, HSL, CMYK color values
• Color harmony generator (complementary, analogous, triadic, tetradic, monochromatic)
• Custom palette builder with export (PNG, SVG, ASE, JSON)
• 10-language support (EN, ES, FR, DE, JA, ZH, PT, KO, AR, HI)
• GPS location tagging for captures
• Dark glassmorphism UI with fluid animations
• Haptic feedback
• Offline-capable with local storage


AI DISCLOSURE
This app uses AI to analyze photos and generate artistic transformations. AI-generated content is for creative and entertainment purposes and may not perfectly represent real-world colors or scenes. Results may vary.

PREMIUM
Unlock unlimited captures, unlimited imaginations, all art styles and moods, ad-free experience, and export in all formats.

review_information.notes:
2. DEVICES AND OS VERSIONS TESTED
Automated tests run on every build: iPhone 17 Pro Max and iPad Pro 13-inch simulators on iOS 26, and a Pixel Android emulator on API 34.
Each release is also installed and launched on those targets, so a
build that cannot start never ships.

3. WHAT THIS APP DOES, AND FOR WHOM
Photriya — the most beautiful color capture and AI imagination app.

Intended audience:
Capture & imagine colours

4. SETTING UP AND REACHING THE MAIN FEATURES
The app opens on a sign-in screen. An account is optional; the main features can be reached without signing in.

5. EXTERNAL SERVICES USED
- Firebase (Google) — app initialisation
- Firebase Authentication (Google) — sign-in
- Supabase — account and data storage
- Google Sign-In — authentication
- Sign in with Apple — authentication
- Apple In-App Purchase — paid features
- device location services (on-device)
- HTTPS requests to the app's own endpoints

6. REGIONAL DIFFERENCES
The app ships 12 languages (Arabic, Chinese (Simplified), English, French, German, Hindi, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, Russian, Spanish). Features are identical in every region.

7. REGULATED INDUSTRY OR THIRD-PARTY MATERIAL

The app is not in a regulated industry and carries no licensed third-party material. All content, artwork and copy are the developer's own.


ACCOUNT DELETION
Account deletion is available in the app under Settings, and on the support site.

Both numbers exclude the ~60 widgets every Flutter app uses — Column, Text,
Padding and so on. Including them makes any two Flutter apps look 97% alike,
which is a property of the framework rather than of these apps.

than 22% of their description vocabulary.
